basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and LEGO enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. I've been gaming since the days of the original NES and have a particular fondness for FPS and strategy games. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, you can find me building intricate LEGO towers or battling it out in Call of Duty. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends at local gaming conventions or exploring the craft beer scene. I usually log onto Reddit in the evenings after work, typically around 7 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of professional experience in software development, I have a strong technical background. My passion for gaming has driven me to stay updated on the latest in gaming technology and trends. I am largely self-taught in LEGO architecture, having spent countless hours experimenting and learning from online forums and communities.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: I am quite familiar with both subreddit-specific and site-wide rules. I tend to adhere strictly to these guidelines, as I believe in maintaining a respectful and organized community environment.
